blocks.text: Nature + Element Home + Life

Planet Green aspires to create a new dimension in the natural farming and alternate real estate segments in India. Through their Vedic farming practices and the creation of green eco-habitats, Planet Green enables urban Indian families to rekindle a deeper connection with nature.
The products or the projects of Planet Green are aimed at the healthy and enriching lives of the families.
Planet Green's flagship project Farm Natura – farm land living community is among the most revered projects of Hyderabad.
People Behind

VINAY RAM is a seasoned Real Estate Management Professional. With over 15 years of experience, he is about to set an impact in the field of construction, his destiny introduced him to the world of natural farming. He restarted his career while understanding the fundamentals of farming. He, with the support of team members has cultivated 10s of acres. There struck a different realization that combines living and farming as a new way of living, under the tree of Planet Green.

As I started interacting with nature through nature-friendly farming, I realize that there are many ways for humans to interact with nature. At Planet Green, we create communities and ecosystems where urbanites can primarily indulge, involve, or impact nature in a positive way. Throughout our communities, elements of nature continue to play a pivotal role.
VINAY RAM , Managing Director
Indian Achievers Award
Vision
"To liberate Mother Nature of her burden so she can heal herself itself, by enlightening her children on the planet to do that for her."
Mission
We will bring humankind close to nature so that man re-learns to make food, re-learns to grow produce, and re-learns to replenish soil just as he in the past.
Nature and Human, a Relationship to Mend.

Over the past half century or so, there has been an increasingly growing interest in and focus on the relationship between nature and humankind. The increased focus on health and well-being, as well as nature's deteriorating health, has triggered this. Over the last hundred years or so, we have become obsessed with progress and development, and this has had an impact on the well-being of humankind. Farming was once a manual process; in fact, it is an organic process by itself. But today, mechanisation has made farming itself a non-organic process with the ways land is tilled, chemicals are used, and food is grown.

That's where Planet Green steps in: to take man back to the times when land existed to nurture humankind and vice versa. At Planet Green, we are on a mission to restore the true value of land in our lives. We are striving to enlighten humankind with ways to handle land the right way. We are about ensuring that the union of life and nature is maintained. Most of all, we are about educating the world on how human life is impacted when the land faces turmoil.
Creating Communities for Nature to Live On
Planet Green is on the path to build communities that will lead a movement to restore Mother Nature back to its real form. We are building communities in diverse spheres comprising:
Dates County
A 300+ acre vast landscape that runs on its own.
Farm Natura
Farm Natura offers a community of like-minded.

We are Green Land Capital. A nature-focused entity.
Veda Bharat
Our traditionally grown rice is a true labor of love.

We only use this information for statistical analysis purposes and then the data is removed from the system. Overall, cookies help us provide you with a better website, by enabling us to monitor which pages you find useful and which you do not. A cookie in no way gives us access to your computer or any information about you, other than the data you choose to share with us.

You can choose to accept or decline cookies. Most web browsers automatically accept cookies, but you can usually modify your browser setting to decline cookies if you prefer. This may prevent you from taking full advantage of the website.

Awards

Mr Vinay Ram, the founder of Planetgreen Infra Pvt Ltd, has been awarded the 'Most Inspiring Green Entrepreneur of the Year award at the Indian Achievers Awards for his efforts in creating nature-friendly and sustainable living spaces and his commitment to the environment for which it has created biodiverse and biodynamic plots. The award ceremony was graced by the honourable Minister of Road Transport and Highways, Shri Nitin Gadkari, who personally presented the award. Vinay Ram's work at Planetgreen has been widely recognized for its innovative approach to sustainable development and construction that are substantial for conserving our planet. The Planetgreen Infra Pvt Ltd team is proud of this achievement and looks forward to continuing its efforts to promote sustainable living in India.
It's us who Needs Nature.

At Planet Green, we want you to make yourself a part of nature in ways you can. Either for indulgence, for happy living, for engaging yourself in cultivating land, or to make the lap of Mother Earth cleaner and greener again. So, through Planet Green, we aspire to create farming eco-systems and living communities that let you.
